name: Hunter Tracking
author: Beinded (JuanBerta)
description: Track specific animals and see them as personal neon-green map markers on the in-game M-key map and minimap (WorldMarker layer). Markers follow the animals live every 0.5 s, respect your configured range, and are cleared when an animal dies, leaves the range, is removed or tracking is toggled off. Add, remove, list or clear tracked species with simple commands, tune the visible range, species limit and marker limit, and use /ht locate to get live bearing, distance and coordinates of the nearest tracked animal.
